name: IS-1 Internet
summary: Sydney dialup ISP (IS-1 Communications Pty Ltd, ACN 076 262 461; FTP/WAV archive, IRC, user pages, ~1996); defunct.

events.details: Defunct. IS-1 branding ended between May 2002 and Sep-Nov 2002 when the homepage became MyISP — c. 2002 as proposed.

refs.label: By 30 Nov 2002 is-1.net.au served the MyISP Internet retail site with no IS-1 branding at all; the rebrand completed in late 2002.
